evidence.V1: Reads instantly as a barrel at 64 px from front, three-quarter and top; silhouette shows the bellied body with both hoops stepping out of the outline; A15 symmetry X/Y 0.0, centred, hoops seated on the staves.
evidence.V2: Big (body) and medium (two hoops, recessed open top with rim) are clear, but the small tier is missing: the staves are vertex-colour stripes only, with no grooves, nails, rivets or chime lip, so the body reads as a flat striped surface.
evidence.V3: Conventional, fairly upright cylinder: gentle bulge, thin hoops of even width, no chunky chime or exaggerated belly, so it only partly reads as confident stylised compared with the chunky flanges of the Pipe_Run anchor.
evidence.V4: The top rim has a soft rounded roll, but the hoops are flat bands with crisp, unbevelled edges that catch no highlight (hoop close-up), so edge treatment is inconsistent.
evidence.V5: No z-fighting, pinches or patches, but visible stray faceting: the polygonal hoop corner shows on the right edge of the hoop close-up, and the rim plus body segments show stepped flat shading in the studio close-ups instead of smooth shading.
evidence.V6: Disciplined: two values of warm wood brown alternating on the staves, a darker interior brown, and the kit gold on the hoops; the walnut and teal colourways keep the same structure.
evidence.V7: 1152 tris against a medium-class target of 2000 (ceiling 4000), under target.
evidence.V8: One white material with vertex colours, kit gold accent and a wood hue in up to 3 values all match; minor mismatch from the faceted rather than smooth shading and the hoops lacking the ~0.045 stud chamfer.
evidence.V9: Studio line is correct: Anchored, Hull collision, CanTouch off, CastShadow on, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre.

artifacts: Polygon corner/faceting visible on the top hoop's outer edge (hoop close-up, right side)
Stepped flat-shaded segments on the rim roll and stave body in the studio close-ups
Stave pattern is colour stripes only, with no geometry separating the staves
top_fixes: Bevel the hoop edges (~0.045 studs) and smooth-shade the hoops and body so the bands catch a highlight and lose the polygon corners
Add a small-detail tier: shallow stave grooves or inset seams, and a few rivets/nails on each hoop
Push the stylisation: thicker, chunkier hoops, a stronger belly and a visible chime lip at top and bottom
